object.attr: derived: review Q58. Such names can exist in a clone made on Linux and become one file on a Windows checkout. Replaces the load errors for two object files with one object ID and two links files with one source, which couldn't happen while a file's name must equal its ID.
object.description: If two files or folders in one folder of a document have names that differ only in letter case, Mellon shall report a load error for the document.
